# Bengaluru Wellness Map

> An interactive map of places, routes, clinics, kitchens and communities for
> looking after yourself in Bengaluru. Compiled by hand by the marketing team
> at Plum, free to use, and not medical advice.

The map needs JavaScript to draw itself. Everything on it is also published as
plain HTML, with no JavaScript at all:

- Every place on the map, grouped by what you want to do: move, play, work out,
  eat healthy, indulge, reset, clear my head, get care, buy gear, fix my
  wearable. See the "list" page alongside the map.

## What it covers

Greater Bengaluru, across the five city corporations. Each entry carries a
name, a neighbourhood, a category, a note on what the place is, and whether we
have checked it. Parks come from the BBMP register; the basemap is
OpenStreetMap via OpenFreeMap.

Last reviewed September 2026.

## Adding to it

Anything missing can be sent to https://tally.so/r/gDEb24
